period_note: Balance sheet is the 30-Sep-2021 period-end snapshot (reported), Solo basis. Income statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2021 (9-month). OCR'd (pdftoppm 300dpi + tesseract). Comparative (31-Dec-2020) column matches this dataset's existing 2020_Q4.json exactly for total_assets (303,516.861297m), total_liabilities (286,570.133912m), total_equity (16,946.727385m), statutory_reserve (6,430.798085m) and off_balance_sheet_exposures (63,852.699814m). Balance-sheet identity holds to rounding (286,653.575735 + 17,787.960587 = 304,441.536322, matches 304,441.536321 reported). statutory_reserve corroborated by the 20%-of-PBT rule (6,430.798085m + 20% x 2,174.535353m = 6,865.705156m, matches 6,865.705155m reported to rounding, and the implied appropriation of 434.907071m matches the reported 9-month Statutory Reserve appropriation exactly). total_deposits (221,359.06653m) is the reported subtotal; the 'Fixed Deposit/Mudaraba fixed deposits' component was not separately legible. nav_per_share was illegible in the current-period column; CALCULATED as total_equity / (paid_up_capital/10) = 17,787.960587m / 934.040456m shares = 19.04. Income statement fully reconciles: NII+investment+commission+other = total_operating_income (4,079.298963+1,420.293094+1,120.463964+406.399053=7,026.455074 exact); operating_profit = total_operating_income - total_operating_expenses (7,026.455074-3,761.395417=3,265.059657 exact); profit_before_tax = operating_profit - total_provision (3,265.059657-1,090.524304=2,174.535353 exact); profit_after_tax = profit_before_tax - tax_expense (2,174.535353-801.980154=1,372.555199, matches 1,372.555198 reported). MINOR RESTATEMENT NOTE: this filing's own contemporaneous 9-month 2021 profit-before-tax (2,174.535353m) and profit-after-tax (1,372.555198m) differ from the same Jan-Sep-2021 period as later shown as a comparative column in onebankplc-q3-2022.txt (PBT 2,208.406707m, PAT 1,393.724795m; current tax 812.065965m vs this filing's own 799.364207m; tax subtotal 814.681912m vs this filing's own 801.980154m) - a small (~1.6%) upward restatement of the 2021 9-month interim comparative in the following year's filing. Per project convention (prefer contemporaneous), this file uses the ORIGINAL, contemporaneous 2021_Q3 figures.
